title: Paired, no agents
summary: A device already paired with this machine, whose core runs with no agent connected. Its state is kept between its runs: pair once in its first run (or after Forget), and every later run starts paired.
steps: First run only: pair with a code from Pairing code, below, as in Fresh install.
Run it again: the page opens paired, on the empty room (no conversation: no agent is connected).
Settings → Machines lists this machine; Settings → Voz and Proveedores are this device's.
Starting a fresh scenario empties the browser here, so this one asks to pair again afterwards; its machine still knows the old device.
